name: Tupiza: Quebrada de Palala and Puerta del Diablo
why: Red rock canyons and spires around Tupiza, the landscape of the last days of Butch Cassidy, on foot up a dry gorge to the Devil's Gate.
book: Free; maps and guides at the Tupiza agencies.
dangers: Sun and heat in the gorge.

points.name: Tupiza
points.note: A small town among red cliffs.

points.name: Puerta del Diablo
points.note: A narrow gate between red rock fins.
